Another tip on, er, tips, is that some home espresso machines may not have enough pressure to properly use a 3-4 hole tip. My Europiccola came with a 3-hole tip but did not have enough pressure to properly steam decent milk. Swapped it for a 1-hole tip and the increase in pressure made a big difference!
